info.title: Sri Lankan Collectible Marketplace API
info.description: REST API for the collectible marketplace (EC8208). Live bid updates are delivered over a Socket.IO namespace (/auctions), documented in docs/API.md.

token.description: Token from the password reset e-mail link

url.description: Object URL returned by the storage service

position.description: Display order, 0 is the cover image

fileUrl.description: Object URL of the uploaded certificate

images.description: Multiple angles showing the item condition

certificates.description: Authenticity certificates submitted for appraiser review

images.description: Multiple angles showing the item condition

fileUrl.description: Object URL returned by the storage service

comments.description: Required when rejecting or requesting more evidence, so the seller knows why

appraisedValue.description: Base value the appraiser places on the item, in LKR

startTime.description: When bidding opens. Defaults to immediately.

buyNowPrice.description: Optional Buy Now price that ends the auction at once

auctionId.description: Auction won by the buyer. Omit for a fixed-price purchase.

listingId.description: Fixed-price listing being bought. Omit when checking out an auction win.

reason.example: Item does not match the listing description

status.description: Approve (ACTIVE), remove (REMOVED) or send back for review

resolutionNote.example: Listing removed and the seller warned

resolution.example: Refunded the buyer in full after inspecting photos

orderAction.description: Applied to the order only when the dispute is RESOLVED. REFUND_BUYER marks the payment refunded in our records; the money itself is returned through the payment provider.

reason.example: Listing appears to be a modern replica
